g.text: Benchmark Line - A benchmark line is the associative of a simulation scenario and a salary line
Simulation scenario of a benchmark line
Salary line of a benchmark line

g.title: HR_SIMULATIONSCENARIOS
g.text: Simulation Scenario - A Scenario is a container of Participants including a selection of attributes, valid at a snapshot date and possibly effective dated hypothesis of change.
The Model the Scenario is built on top of.
The name of the simulation scenario.
The description/purpose of the simulation scenario.
The status of the simulation scenario.
The date the initial participant snapshot will be taken at.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, it is the dimension X that will be used for analysis. For example Salary Grade.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, it is the dimension Y that will be used for analysis. For example, Base Salary.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, indicates if the scenario analysis will take advantage of a graph frame.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, indicates the graph frame that will be used, maning the set of salary lines insisting on the same X and Y dimension as the scenario’s.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, this is the date where the compensation hypothesis is supposed to be effective from.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, this is the salary line that will be used when the Match Policy Line command is selected from the actions.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model, this is the guideline that will be used when the Use Guideline command is selected.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model and a Apply Guideline is selected, this field indicates if the Min or the Max of the guideline will be used.
If the scenario is based on the Salary Analysis model this field is used if and, in which case, what type of budget constraint applying.
Use this flag if you would like to initialise each scenario participant with the performance score they achieved at the snapshot date.
Choose the score component you would like to use to initialise the participant perforformance field.
Indicates the date and time of creation

Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
Indicates the initialization status for the Simulation Scenario

g.title: HR_SALARYLINE
g.text: Salary Lines - Use this entity to store salary benchmarks useful for analysing your employee’s salaries against recommended market guidelines or internal policies.
Salary Line validity period start date
Includes the description of the salary line
Salary Line validity period start date
Salary Line validity period end date
Identify the set of possible values in the X Axis
identify the set of possible values in the Y Axis (typically referring to a remuneration component)
The datasource that can be useful to retrieve the information for the calculation of the automatic increases
Includes the Agency this salary line comes from
This field identifies what would be the source of the line points at choice between “Actual compensation”, “Benchmark data” or “Manual input”
Depending on the source selected, you can choose a formula between Average, Median, Min and Max
This is a set with Root person and it’s used to identify the population of employees that will be used to induce the salary line Y value.
